tick-sync.option.enabled.tooltip: Enables client tick synchronization after 10 movement timing samples, with a fresh sample on the current tick. Idle gaps reset sampling. Default: ON.
tick-sync.option.margin.tooltip: Target packet delay from 1 to 40ms. Set to 0 for automatic adjustment. Default: Auto.
tick-sync.option.minimumFps.tooltip: Pauses new sync adjustments at or below this FPS. Default: 40 FPS.
tick-sync.option.syncCooldownMs.tooltip: Minimum wait between completed sync adjustments. Lower values react sooner but may adjust more often. Default: 1000ms.
tick-sync.option.maxStepMs.tooltip: Maximum timing correction per client tick. Smaller steps spread corrections over more ticks. Default: 4ms.
tick-sync.option.clampTolerance.tooltip: Allowed delay above the manual tick delay clamp before adjusting again. Only affects manual mode. Default: 5ms.
tick-sync.option.debug.tooltip: Shows TickSync status and packet timing in game. Default: OFF.
tick-sync.option.enableTelemetry.tooltip: Writes local diagnostics to ticksync-log.txt in the game folder and on the desktop. Default: ON.
tick-sync.option.hudPosition.tooltip: Chooses the corner for the debug HUD. Default: Top Right.
tick-sync.option.hudTextShadow.tooltip: Adds shadows behind debug HUD text. Default: ON.
tick-sync.option.showDelay.tooltip: Shows average movement packet delay in the debug HUD. Default: ON.
tick-sync.option.showJitter.tooltip: Shows packet jitter and the target cushion in the debug HUD. Default: ON.
tick-sync.option.showPacketStats.tooltip: Shows ticks with movement callbacks in the last 20 client ticks and late packet-to-tick samples. This does not measure network packet loss. Default: ON.
tick-sync.option.showPuckStatus.tooltip: Shows the puck smoothness estimate in the debug HUD. Default: ON.
tick-sync.option.showHistogram.tooltip: Shows the packet delay histogram below the debug HUD. Default: ON.
